caption:
What real strength looks like when you are angry

The Prophet ﷺ said the strong man is not the one who wrestles well, but the one who controls himself in a fit of rage. The next time anger rises, that moment is your real test of strength.

Sahih Muslim 6643 · Grade: Sahih
